dispositions.evidence: OMP assignment argv is unchanged from base455a99b workspace.cpp:203; catalog extraction preserves the verified adapter contract.
PATH-first executable discovery and fallback paths are unchanged from base455a99b workspace.cpp:139-145. macOS is the active target; arbitrary non-PATH Linux installations are out of scope.
Only one scoped LinkReceiver exists in terminal_input_test.cpp:584. CTest processes have separate QDesktopServices registries; no overlapping instance path exists.
live_connection.cpp:592 rejects a second request while outstanding_history_request_ is set, before deferred_history_ can be overwritten. No unbounded history queue is intended.
The injected ServiceLauncher is authoritative and its failure is tested. Falling back would unexpectedly launch a real process after an injected failure.
Qt6 qprocess.h:136 declares non-static bool startDetached(qint64* = nullptr); the static overload at240 requires a program. live_connection.cpp:35 calls the configured instance.
Requested Doxygen coverage for private helpers does not identify a current behavioral defect; queueHistoryRequest already documents frozen-screen ordering.
Same incorrect static-overload premise as6. The instance startDetached uses configured output/error redirection; existing real-service tests cover log creation.
The independent strict legacy decoder is intentional compatibility evidence. A fixed-format mixed-version probe should fail when negotiated bytes drift; no current parse error identified.
check_cpp.py already states moc consumes the annotation and the C++ compiler sees a no-op. Q_MOC_INCLUDE is a Qt-defined annotation, not product code.
PR24 intentionally targets fix/consolidated-quality; the live branch and PR base both exist. CodeRabbit used base configuration, so this review was manually triggered.

session_descriptor.cpp:232 sets canceled before removing endpoint ownership; commit at252 rejects it before serial/rename, even if endpoint state is recreated. Controlled replacement writer test covers this interleaving.
Lock acquisition is a partial order owners then endpoint then lifecycle; no reverse acquisition exists. The finding itself admits no current cycle and hypothesizes future edits.
Pinned Ghostty grid_ref.h:187-191 declares size_t *out_len. std::size_t matches; production compilation validates pointer compatibility.
architecture.md explicitly states joined views remain terminal-only and no phone attention capability is added. Primary-only attention is intentional.
Naming the bounded64 temporary-name attempts is optional style with no defect or acceptance gap.
terminal.cpp:69 already requires lead>=0xc2; C0/C1 are rejected directly. The finding cites code that is not present in the reviewed head.
harness_catalog.cpp:27-40 keeps the switch exhaustive after the early unsupported return; removing its enum case triggers switch diagnostics.
live_connection.cpp:35 calls the configured instance overload. Installed Qt qprocess.h declares nonstatic startDetached(qint64*); same premise rejected in the prior review.
live_connection.hpp:48-65 already declares queueHistoryRequest and clearDescriptorWrite under private.

live_connection.cpp:375-386 times out deferred requests, fail() invalidates them, and begin():408 resets pending_resize_. An unresponsive service cannot supply synchronized history; requests fail boundedly and reconnect clears the size state.
Smart pointers and optionals initialize empty; capability_retry_ has a brace initializer. No uninitialized read or changed type exists.
visible_link accepts syntactically valid hosts without doing DNS on the GUI thread. www.example is a two-label domain; whether a domain resolves is not a parser correctness test.

linkTarget():1099 accepts localhost or the runtime local hostname, not arbitrary DNS aliases. QSysInfo does not guarantee a short name as asserted. Alias expansion is outside the documented local-file qualification, not a demonstrated regression.
linkOpened denotes accepted dispatch, with failure logged at mousePressEvent():1131. The only connected consumer is a fixture; no claimed analytics/fallback consumer exists.

workspace.cpp:111-122 intentionally maps only uniquely identifiable managed adapters. terminal mode cannot identify which of several CLIs ran; preserving an empty id avoids inventing identity. Behavior is unchanged from the base.
launchMode():99-109 exhausts all current enums without a default; -Wall/-Werror already diagnose adding an unhandled enum. Replacing the fallback with unreachable adds no current behavior coverage.

LinkReceiver is a scoped test fixture with synchronous handler registration. No tested throwing partial-registration path exists; speculative allocation failure does not justify a new rollback framework.
The fixture invokes and destroys the URL receiver synchronously on one thread. No concurrent receive/destruction path exists.
LinkReceiver inherits QObject, whose copy operations are deleted. Its user-declared destructor and nonmovable base prevent the suggested copy/move scenario.
The Return press triggers the field commit; Qt does not require matching text on release. No differing validation result was demonstrated.
ui_preview_test.cpp:60 defines CHECK using require, which throws runtime_error; there is no continuing test-framework failure collector to bypass.
Either invalid flag/platform combination exits with a diagnostic. Error precedence is optional polish, not a false passing check.
focusedFolder is compared to a nonempty temporary project path at ui_preview_test.cpp:2429. An invalid QVariant converts to empty and fails the existing assertion.
The receipt hashes bind dated test inputs; they are not a claimed supply-chain verification mechanism. CONTRIBUTING explicitly defines evidence source hashes and reuse obligations.
The sanitizer receipt names suites and modes with commands/scope. It does not claim coverage metrics or whole-application clearance; supplementary case counts are optional.

Native input/GPU/external handlers and upgrading running user services are explicitly unqualified in the receipt and PR. This repeats the recorded boundary rather than identifying an unreported defect.
Paired the synthetic Backspace press with a release in ui_preview_test.cpp. This improves fixture fidelity; no production key handling changed.
The observation_phase include exposes the attention namespace type to consumers; unused local references do not establish a broken API. Removing the umbrella exposure is optional include cleanup.
The strict independent wire decoder deliberately fixes v6 layout offsets so compatibility drift fails at runtime. Sharing production constants would reduce oracle independence.
Explicit 0x80/0xC0 bytes are intentional independent compatibility expectations, verified against real service replies.
READY forwards the sequence from the validated snapshot envelope. A named offset could improve readability; no incorrect bytes are sent.
Each capability iteration must resize to a new size to force a fresh legacy snapshot; 79 then 78 provides that distinction.
The example.com fixture string is repeated only for independent producer/consumer verification; factoring it is optional.

Descriptor cleanup is best-effort and nonthrowing, including destruction. Stage/fsync/rename failures are reported. Retrying close after an error can close a reused fd; denied unlink can leave a temporary file, an environmental cleanup limit rather than proof of a synchronization defect.

write_descriptor has a throwing contract. prepare, stage and converted commit failures all propagate exceptions to that one caller boundary; callers do not need separate error protocols. Serial wrap would violate ordering.
session_descriptor.hpp includes local_protocol.hpp, which explicitly includes QByteArray, QString and QtGlobal. Standalone inclusion compiles; adding redundant direct includes is optional.
Waiting for another thread to release a mutex is not a deadlock. The established owners->endpoint->lifecycle order has no reversed acquisition or self-cycle in the cited destruction path.

before_commit is an intentional pre-lock test barrier; the final endpoint/cancellation validation happens afterward. Acquiring the lock around the hook would prevent the tested cancellation interleaving.
Join flag 3 is explicitly commented in the independent v6 wire fixture; naming it is optional test readability.
LNK1 is an independently asserted wire marker; changing the production marker must fail this compatibility fixture.

The attach flags/identity layout is the v6 contract for discover and join, not a coincidence. The fixture validates the returned identity, snapshot and live child; format drift does not silently pass.
points is a local count used to calculate the codepoint-section length; renaming it is optional and does not change parsing.
local_protocol.hpp explicitly includes QtGlobal. The descriptor implementation obtains quint64 from that required protocol dependency, not accidentally from QUuid.
CMakeLists.txt:8-9 requires C++20. std::atomic supports trivially copyable enum types before C++20 as well.
shared_ptr(T*) deletes the supplied object if control-block allocation fails. The raw-pointer construction does not leak and precedes endpoint registration intentionally.
State destruction occurs at last ownership, without concurrent access. Its private cleanup helper can therefore run without locking; acquiring a mutex adds no safety.
Cancel removes map ownership only after marking the old ticket canceled; a new endpoint serial domain cannot revive that ticket. Existing replacement tests cover this identity boundary.
client_hyperlinks_ and client_attention_phase_ already have brace default initializers. Moving them to a constructor list changes style only.
DescriptorStore exposes a narrow test hook, not a general customization framework. Making state transitions virtual or making a hook-bearing class final would change the intended contract.
Current callers retain the shared_ptr for the duration of commit. Destroying ownership and then dereferencing a dangling reference is caller misuse, not a present lifetime bug.
commit returns a documented error QString and is nodiscard. Replacing this established API with a Result type is broader optional refactoring.
The hook is used for controlled scheduling, not inspecting/mutating private descriptor state. Additional public accessors have no concrete consumer.
The header already states one worker stages/commits while the owning UI thread may cancel. No missing current thread-ownership rule was identified.
add_hyperlink first caps uri.size at max_hyperlink_uri_bytes, below the global budget. The subtraction cannot underflow; the proposed addition form can overflow.
observation_phase is a capability boolean and snapshot.observation_phase is explicitly qualified; parameter renaming is optional readability.
The nonnegative bounded byte size and 0/1 addition are safe under the current types. Existing -Wconversion/-Wsign-conversion checks pass; no overflow or comparison error is present.

limits: Background Qt/software evidence does not qualify native macOS drop/input or GPU behavior.
The new OCR result was partial; its leads were inspected directly after the read-only GLM worker hit a provider rate limit.
Known alias-file-URL, native qualification and environmental descriptor-cleanup limits remain recorded as limits, not silently counted as tested.
